title: Sharp ATE Bounds under Mixed Missingness with External Audit Moments and Label Error
banked_reason: N-thin-survey — unavailable Palomba manuscript is material; without theorem-level comparison or a targeted audit/data-fusion survey, field-tier novelty is unsupported and the evidenced kernel is letter-tier below novelty_target=field.
gap_reasons: N-thin-survey — unavailable Palomba manuscript is material; without theorem-level comparison or a targeted audit/data-fusion survey, field-tier novelty is unsupported and the evidenced kernel is letter-tier below novelty_target=field.
proof_attempt_summary: The proposal developed sharp aggregate-audit ATE bounds and then received one non-identical revision that repaired the information experiment, target wording, and audit-label/transport assumptions. Correctness and coherence defects cleared, but the novelty review again found only letter-tier support because the material adjacent manuscript was unavailable and no concrete operational audit design established field-level non-subsumption. The mathematical kernel remains suitable for re-raising if theorem-level comparison and real audit evidence become available.
tldr: How much does an external arm-specific audit reveal about the all-target-member ATE when it releases only two weighted informative-missingness label moments and its labels have bounded error? The proposal derives the exact feasible informative masses and a full-law sharp four-support ATE interval, quantifies the gap from constant-share analyses, and develops pointwise inference at ties and contacts. This connects realistic audit design and label validation to mixed-missingness causal bounds.
gap: The verified mixed-missingness bounds use unrestricted or cellwise informative shares. Existing pooled-budget work addresses another attrition target; general auxiliary-information and misclassification methods do not supply this target-weighted, error-bounded audit identified set with full causal-law attainment. Palomba’s announced full draft is not public, so exact theorem-level overlap cannot be certified.
fill: Characterize the exact informative-mass interval from the specified external audit experiment, prove complete-law sharp ATE endpoints, and establish finite-cell pointwise inference accounting jointly for calibration clipping, support ties, and main/audit covariance.
